title: Structural and Thermodynamic Discrimination between Agonists and Antagonists of Retinoic Acid Receptor gamma and the Vitamin D Receptor.
authors: Zolek, Teresa; Sutula, Szymon; Kutner, Andrzej
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核受体RARgamma和VDR的激动剂/拮抗剂配体识别，采用MD和MM-PBSA计算配体结合热力学，但对象为核受体-小分子配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可迁移，故评分较低。
abstract: Synthetic ligands of retinoic acid receptor gamma (RARgamma) and vitamin D receptor (VDR) can act as agonists or antagonists by reshaping receptor conformation and cofactor recruitment, yet the structural and energetic determinants of this selectivity remain incompletely defined. Here, we present an integrated structural and thermodynamic analysis combining conformational characterization, molecular dynamics simulations, and molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann surface area calculations to compare representative agonists and antagonists of human RARgamma and VDR. Binding free energies and effective enthalpic contributions were evaluated for selected ligands, whereas the apparent entropic term, estimated indirectly as -TDeltaS(app) = DeltaG(bind) - DeltaH(eff), was used only as a qualitative internal descriptor. The thermodynamic profiles indicate that effective enthalpic stabilization is a more informative comparative descriptor than binding free energy alone, with clear agonist-antagonist separation for RARgamma and a directional, less statistically resolved trend for VDR. These energetic patterns were interpreted alongside ligand-dependent stabilization of helix 12 and receptor-ligand interaction networks. Newly determined MicroED structures of AGN194310 and AGN205728 were incorporated as ligand-specific conformational references, improving structural definition without being treated as direct evidence of receptor-bound bioactive conformations. Comparative analysis of RARgamma and VDR suggests that functional selectivity is not governed solely by affinity but emerges from the interplay among ligand-binding energetics, interaction networks, and receptor conformational dynamics. These results provide a retrospective mechanistic benchmark for interpreting agonist- and antagonist-associated behavior in nuclear receptors and may guide future studies on functionally selective modulators.
abstract_zh: 维甲酸受体γ（RARgamma）和维生素D受体（VDR）的合成配体可通过重塑受体构象和辅因子募集来发挥激动剂或拮抗剂作用，然而这种选择性的结构和能量决定因素仍未完全明确。在此，我们提出了一种整合的结构与热力学分析，结合构象表征、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积计算，以比较人RARgamma和VDR的代表性激动剂和拮抗剂。对选定的配体评估了结合自由能和有效焓贡献，而表观熵项则通过间接估计为 -TDeltaS(app) = DeltaG(bind) - DeltaH(eff)，仅用作定性内部描述符。热力学谱表明，有效焓稳定化是比单独结合自由能更具信息量的比较描述符，对RARgamma显示出清晰的激动剂-拮抗剂分离，对VDR则显示出方向性但统计分辨率较低的趋势。这些能量模式与配体依赖性螺旋12稳定化及受体-配体相互作用网络一同被解读。新确定的AGN194310和AGN205728的MicroED结构被纳入作为配体特异性构象参考，改善了结构定义，但未被视为受体结合生物活性构象的直接证据。对RARgamma和VDR的比较分析表明，功能选择性并非仅由亲和力决定，而是源于配体结合能量学、相互作用网络和受体构象动力学之间的相互作用。这些结果为解释核受体中激动剂和拮抗剂相关行为提供了回顾性机制基准，并可能指导未来对功能选择性调节剂的研究。
